source_file: January listening placeholder generated from dashboard social performance

strengths: Owned social performance in January was solid, with 843 total engagements and a 5.95% weighted engagement rate.
LinkedIn drove the clearest interaction signal with 287 engagements and 720 link clicks.
Instagram delivered 2,003 views while Facebook added 78 reactions, showing multi-platform support even without archived listening data.
vulnerabilities: No January Talkwalker report is currently archived in the dashboard data folder, so this month can only show social-performance-led interpretation.
Without a month-specific listening export, media-type mix, unique authors, and site breadth cannot be measured for January.
opportunities: Backfill the January Talkwalker export later if it is recovered from Outlook or Downloads so month-over-month listening trends can start from January.
Use January as the baseline owned-media month when comparing February and March listening concentration and engagement quality.
content_ideas: Summarize which January LinkedIn content themes drove the highest clicks and carry those into future listening comparisons.
Pair January social highlights with the January web analytics results to show which owned topics also pulled site traffic.
discussion_points: January is now loadable in the Social Listening tab, but it is a placeholder month until the underlying Talkwalker export is recovered.
The owned-channel signal suggests LinkedIn was the strongest January platform for interaction and traffic-driving performance.
insights.summary: January listening has been backfilled as a placeholder month so the dashboard can load it consistently. It does not contain archived Talkwalker results yet; the narrative is based on January owned social performance only.
